physics-killer-01.title: Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy (Inquiry)
physics-killer-01.goal: Analyze the principles of Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
physics-killer-01.material: Pamusoro peroller coaster rail isina friction, chinhu chinotanga chichimira pamusoro pe point A pakukwirira $50\,\mathrm{m}$. Kukwirira kwepoints nhatu pa rail kwakaita sepatafura. Point B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, point C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, point D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Usatarise kuramba kwemhepo uye $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kana, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama (kumhanya paC kupfuura kumhanya paB ka-ngani) nokumhanya paD zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Pamusoro peroller coaster rail isina friction, chinhu chinotanga chichimira pamusoro pe point A pakukwirira $50\,\mathrm{m}$. Kukwirira kwepoints nhatu pa rail kwakaita sepatafura. Point B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, point C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, point D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Usatarise kuramba kwemhepo uye $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ kana, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama (kumhanya paC kupfuura kumhanya paB ka-ngani) nokumhanya paD zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: Sezvo kuri kumira paA, kubva $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ pa $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Saka $v_C/v_B=2$ ka, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kumhanya hakuenderani nokukwirira kwakadonhedzwa asi $\sqrt{\Delta h}$, (nhema ①), kana kuti kukwirira $5\,\mathrm{m}$ kwatorwa sekwakadonhedzwa $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (nhema ③), kana kukanganwa $\frac12$ kunopa $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (nhema ④).

physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
